build.buildCommand: if [ -n "$GAME" ]; then pnpm --filter "./games/$GAME" run build --base=./; else echo "the gateway has no build step"; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ -n "$GAME" ]; then COMMIT_SHA="$RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" pnpm --filter "./games/$GAME" run server; else COMMIT_SHA="$RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" pnpm --filter ./server/gateway run start; fi
